what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Colombia in all host countries combined: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 303273 Colombian asylum seekers, and the United States hosts the largest share, 62.7%.
Spain and Canada are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia from 1995 to 2025, at war level in 1996 and from 1999 to 2005.
The groups fighting the government over that time include the ELN, the FARC, EPL–Los Pelusos, FARC-EMC and FARC - Segunda Marquetalia.

when.text: The number of Colombian asylum seekers peaked at 397872 in 2024 and was 303273 at the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.
Refugees from Colombia, counted in a separate series, were most numerous in 2007.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided.
People displaced inside Colombia are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
